*Hartford gate kiosk incident, 3 Aug 2026 (ticket INC-4821)*
• *First report:* 10:42 AM. Both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan. The guard logged trailers on paper in the meantime.
• *Kiosk 1 back:* 11:03 AM. Mateo reported that the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
• *Both lanes confirmed working:* 11:07 AM, confirmed in the channel at 11:08 AM.

Also worth including: scheduling from the dispatch office was unaffected throughout, and Carrowmere Cloud was checking the gateway route. Mateo's status-page access problem was a separate issue and was still open at the last update, tracked under INC-4821.
